## Install

**Windows 10 or 11:** download `Windmill-Windows-Setup.exe` and run it. The installer isn't signed yet, so Windows may warn you: choose **More info → Run anyway**. Press **Ctrl + Win** any time for the Windmill panel. Already have Windmill? Run the new installer and it updates in place, keeping your settings.

**Android 7 or newer:** download `Windmill-Android.apk` on your phone and open it (allow installing from your browser when asked). On your PC, open Windmill → Phone → Let my phone connect, then type the code it shows into the phone. Any network works. No Android? Open thatmaxwell.github.io/Windmill/app/#remote in any phone's browser.
